source.value: Rippers Unmasked — Core Rulebook v1.1 (Elemental Shroud)

summary.value: You weave magical energy and protect the targets from the fury of the elements.

system.description: You weave magical energy and protect the targets from the fury of the elements. Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire or ice. Until this spell ends, each target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type.
